Yes — for a stay of about two months (60 days), you'll need a visa. Germans get 45 days visa-free (unilateral exemption, currently extended until 2028-03-05), but that doesn't cover a 60-day trip, so you'll need to apply for an e-Visa instead.

The e-Visa covers up to 90 days, costs USD 25 (single entry) or USD 50 (multiple entry), takes about 2-3 business days to process, and is usable at any of the ~83 approved air/land/sea ports — apply at evisa.gov.vn.

One more thing to check: your passport needs to be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date.

This is based on data as of 2026-08-17 — double-check current policy at evisa.gov.vn before you travel.
